name: optimate
description: Social media scheduler: write, schedule and publish social media posts to 13 platforms from your Optimate account.

positive.prompt: Using Optimate, how did my social posts do over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of reach, engagement and follower change per connected platform.

positive.description: Find the best time to post.
positive.prompt: When is the best time for me to post on Bluesky this week?
positive.expected_behavior: The best days and hours to post, based on the account's own history.

positive.prompt: Make a branded graphic that says '3 ways to beat the Monday rush' as a tip.
positive.expected_behavior: A link to a graphic in the brand's logo and colours with the exact headline.

positive.prompt: Draft a Bluesky post announcing our new opening hours and save it as a draft in Optimate.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms a draft was saved and shows its text; nothing is published.

positive.prompt: Schedule a post to my Bluesky account for tomorrow at 9am saying 'Fresh pastries from 8am every Saturday.'
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview, asks for confirmation, then confirms the scheduled time.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general writing help.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
Send an email to my accountant about last month's invoices.

negative.description: Do not trigger for other people's accounts.
negative.prompt: How many followers does Taylor Swift have on Instagram?

review.commerce_description: Optimate does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: New add_photo tool: attach your own photo to the chat and ChatGPT adds it to your Optimate media, ready to schedule. Listing now names all 13 platforms (Telegram and Discord added).

interface.longDescription:
Create, schedule and publish social media posts with ChatGPT.

Optimate is a social media scheduler for small businesses, creators and agencies. Connect your Optimate account to plan content, create branded posts and manage your social media in plain language.

With Optimate, you can:
- Set up your brand from your website in a few minutes.
- Write posts in your brand voice and adapt them for different platforms.
- Schedule a week of content, publish now on supported platforms, or save drafts for later.
- Create graphics using your logo, colours and font, or add text to your own photos.
- Post your own photos: attach a photo to the chat and ChatGPT adds it to your Optimate media, ready to schedule.
- Review, edit or cancel scheduled posts.
- Check reach, engagement, follower changes and your top-performing posts.
- Find your best days and times to post based on your own history.
- Reuse your Instagram posts across other platforms.
- Review your Inbox and get suggested replies in your brand voice.
- Compare your Instagram and YouTube performance with competitors.
- Agencies: run every client from one login. Switch between client brands, each with its own accounts, voice and calendar.
- Check which posts are waiting for client approval, and pull weekly or monthly client reports.
- Work as a team: everyone keeps the same permissions they have in Optimate.

Schedule posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, X, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram, Discord and Google Business Profile. Features and formats vary by platform.

ChatGPT shows you a preview and asks for confirmation before scheduling or publishing. Inbox replies are sent by you from the Optimate app.

An Optimate account is required. Features vary by plan.

Try asking:
"Create a week of social media posts for my business."
"Create a branded graphic and schedule it to Instagram."
"How did my social media posts perform this month?"
